'''''Erigeron acris''''' is a widespread species of [[herbaceous plant|herbaceous]] [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Asteraceae]]. Common names include '''bitter fleabane''' and '''blue fleabane'''. The species is native to Canada, colder parts of the United States,<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=250066543 Flora of North America, ''Erigeron acris'' Linnaeus, Sp. Pl. 2: 863. 1753.  Fleabane ]</ref><ref>[http://bonap.net/MapGallery/State/Erigeron%20acris.png Biota of North America Program, 2014 state-level distribution map, ''Erigeron acris'']</ref> northern, central, and southeastern Asia,<ref name=katherinejaneway>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=250066543 Flora of China, ''Erigeron acris'' Linnaeus, Sp. Pl. 2: 863. 1753. <big>飞蓬</big> fei peng ]</ref> and most of Europe.<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=erigeron+acer Altervista Flora Italiana, Cespica acre, ''Erigeron acer'' L.]</ref>

''Erigeron acris'' is a [[Biennial plant|biennial]] or [[perennial plant|perennial]] herb up to 100 cm (40 inches) tall, producing a [[taproot]] and a woody [[rhizome]]. One plant can produce many small [[flower heads]], each with pink, [[Lilac (color)|lilac]], or occasionally white [[ray florets]] and yellow [[disc floret]]s.<ref name=katherinejaneway/>
